adoptionRule: Do not turn DentalGest into a generic ERP. Adopt only common organization patterns that strengthen the dental product.
businessRole: Dental clinic SaaS with clinical records, appointments, treatments, invoices and dental inventory.

betaDecision.siatPolicy: Internal billing, payments, balances and export readiness from day one. Live SIAT fiscal emission stays gated until provider/authorization/testing responsibilities are validated.

entityMappings.notes: Clinic staff profile and role layer already exist.
Could represent reception, clinical, billing, lab and management, but not required for clinical MVP.
Patients are clinical domain records, not generic contacts. Avoid flattening clinical data into core contacts.

Clinical appointments and treatment follow-up can surface as work items without replacing their domain models. OniaCoreWorkItem instalado (Sprint 1); Appointment/PatientTreatment/Invoice siguen como dominio.
Useful for recalls, treatment plans, lab follow-up, consent and billing routines.
Evidence must respect clinical privacy and stay tied to dental domain rules.
AuditLog can satisfy activity history after contract alignment.
Could support patient or inventory import with strict validation.
Dental labs, suppliers and insurers can be partners. Patient stays a clinical domain record, never flattened into a partner.
Needed for fine roles: owner/admin, doctor, reception, cash, assistant. Cash must not edit clinical history; doctor must not touch fiscal config.
Internal threads on patient, treatment, appointment or budget. Must respect clinical privacy.
Consents, referenced radiographs, signed budgets and payment receipts with clinical visibility rules. Storage stays external.
Approvals for discounts, budget acceptance, cancellations or sensitive fiscal changes.
Appointment already covers clinical scheduling. ScheduleEvent adds recalls, follow-ups and reminders without replacing Appointment.
Powers the owner dashboard: saved views per role (owner, doctor, reception, cash).
ClinicSettings ya guarda el canal WhatsApp; falta registro general de correos/telefonos de la clinica con ruteo a recepcion/caja.

blockedUntil: Dental-specific workflows defined before generic task UI
Fiscal/SIAT provider, authorization and testing responsibilities validated before live fiscal emission

installedEntities.notes: Primera entidad core en prod. Tenant guard + dedupe + transiciones en lib/onia-core/.
Visibilidad: STAFF no ve notas clinicas; finance solo ADMIN+.
Solo metadata; archivo en Supabase Storage via storageRef.
descuento/anulacion/cambio de plan; decide ADMIN+; cola en cockpit.
